title: Beyond Stars: MTTX Brings Developer Responsiveness to Dependency Decisions, from Dashboard to IDE to GitHub Actions
abstract: arXiv:2611.23285v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern software reuses open-source packages as dependencies, and developers often choose among candidate packages with cheap signals, such as GitHub stars and download counts. However, such signals are easy to fake, so developers need signals that represent "observed behavior," such as how quickly the developers of a package respond to new dependency releases and to security fixes. Prior work computed these responsiveness metrics, MTTU (Mean Time To Update) dependencies and MTTR (Mean Time To Remediate) vulnerable dependencies, but only with a research prototype for a fixed set of packages. Therefore, developers cannot easily benefit from them or integrate them into their workflow. We present MTTX, an open-source tool that computes MTTU and MTTR with accurate historical dependency resolution for any package and given time window, and brings them into different phases of developer workflow. MTTX resolves each version constraint of npm, Py

translated_title: 超越星标：MTTX 将开发者响应能力引入依赖决策，覆盖仪表盘、IDE 到 GitHub Actions
translated_abstract: 现代软件将开源包作为依赖进行复用，开发者常常依赖廉价的信号（如 GitHub 星标数和下载量）在候选包之间做出选择。然而，这类信号很容易被伪造，因此开发者需要能够反映“可观察行为”的信号，例如包的维护者对新依赖版本发布和安全修复的响应速度。先前的工作已经计算出这些响应能力指标——MTTU（依赖平均更新时间）和 MTTR（易受攻击依赖的平均修复时间）——但仅通过针对固定包集合的研究原型实现。因此，开发者难以从中受益，也无法将其集成到自己的工作流程中。我们提出了 MTTX，这是一个开源工具，可以对任意包及给定时间窗口，通过精确的历史依赖解析来计算 MTTU 和 MTTR，并将这些指标带入开发者工作流程的不同阶段。MTTX 解析 npm、Py
tldr: MTTX 是一个开源工具，通过精确的历史依赖解析为任意包计算 MTTU 和 MTTR 这两项难以伪造的响应能力指标，并将其集成到从仪表盘、IDE 到 GitHub Actions 的开发者工作流程各环节中。
en_tdlr: MTTX is an open-source tool that computes MTTU and MTTR—hard-to-fake responsiveness metrics—for any package via accurate historical dependency resolution, integrating them into developer workflows from dashboards to IDEs to GitHub Actions.
